polityNote: Federation of Nigeria (independent 1960-10-01), from 1961-06-01 when Northern Cameroons joined the Northern Region. Atoms are the 774 LGAs of geoBoundaries NGA ADM2 (GRID3 2022, CC BY 4.0); each LGA lies wholly in one of today's 36 states + FCT (sampled interior points, share 1.00 for all 774), and each state of 1967–1996 is a union of whole LGAs except where a recorded transfer split one (FCT 1976, Andoni/Opobo 1976, the Tarakiri «Ughelli» communities 1976, Bakassi, the Lake Chad villages) — those units are withheld. Rewritten from ne-admin1 on 2026-10-06 because LGA atoms carry the Kogi (Benue/Kwara), Ebonyi (Abia/Enugu) and Borgu (Kwara→Niger 1991) lines that state atoms could not; the ne version had drawn Niger unchanged since 1976, which the Borgu transfer contradicts. Bakassi (Nigerian-administered until 2008-08-14) and Darak/Lake Chad villages lie outside the NGA atoms (GRID3 follows the ICJ line). ① 1993-01-01 (30 states + FCT), union area of the drawn units ÷ the 1991 areas in the statoids table, for the 29 units with a figure: 0.90–1.10 (median 1.00); the units reshaped by this rewrite agree — Abia with Afikpo 1.03, Enugu with Abakaliki 0.97, Kogi 0.97, Kwara 0.91, Benue 0.91, Niger with Borgu 0.93 (without the Afikpo/Abakaliki LGAs Abia and Enugu would be 0.76 and 0.60).

sources.says: Eastern split into East-Central, Rivers, South-Eastern; Northern into six states; Western into Lagos (Colony province + federal territory) and Western; Mid-Western became a state.

sources.title: Statoids — States of Nigeria: 1976-02-03 entry
sources.says: Seven new states and FCT (from parts of Niger and Plateau); Igala moved Kwara→Benue, Ughelli Mid-Western→Rivers, Opobo South-Eastern→Rivers.

sources.title: Statoids — States of Nigeria: 1987-09-23 entry
sources.says: Akwa Ibom split from Cross River; Katsina split from Kaduna.

sources.title: Statoids — States of Nigeria: 1991-08-27 entry
sources.says: Abia from Imo; Bendel into Delta and Edo; Enugu from Anambra; Gongola into Adamawa and Taraba; Jigawa from Kano; Kebbi from Sokoto; Kogi from parts of Benue and Kwara; Osun from Oyo; Yobe from Borno.

sources.title: Statoids — States of Nigeria: 1996-10-01 entry
sources.says: Bayelsa from Rivers; Ebonyi from parts of Abia and Enugu; Ekiti from Ondo; Gombe from Bauchi; Nasarawa from Plateau; Zamfara from Sokoto.

sources.title: Statoids — States of Nigeria: 1996-10-01 entry
sources.says: Bayelsa from Rivers; Ebonyi from parts of Abia and Enugu; Ekiti from Ondo; Gombe from Bauchi; Nasarawa from Plateau; Zamfara from Sokoto.

unresolved.what: Six 1967 states whose lines moved in 1976: North-Western, Benue-Plateau, Kwara, Mid-Western, Rivers, South-Eastern

The Tarakiri communities of Ughelli division went Mid-Western→Rivers and a large part of Andoni/Opobo South-Eastern→Rivers (the remaining Andoni is Eastern Obolo, Akwa Ibom), so the 1967–76 Rivers line runs inside today's Bayelsa/Rivers LGAs; South-Eastern also held Bakassi.
